{{Top|leg}}
'''Spheroids''' was an [[Arcade game/Legends|arcade game]]. [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]] visiting the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] had a number of entertainment options, including an arcade room that featured Spheroids, among other games. In ''Galladinium's Fantastic Technology'' catalogue, the remark is made, "It's said the universe invented the game of Spheroids", because the movements of the eponymous game balls resembled the orbits of planets. The object of the game was to throw, bounce, deflect, and redirect the balls into goals on a table.
